---
title: "Syllabus"
subtitle: "What the four weeks look like"
---

A four-week, ungraded elective, delivered over Zoom, for fourth-year medical
students. Two live sessions a week, one chapter of this book before each, and
one running assignment, the [weekly resource log](resource-log.qmd). Nothing
in the course needs an install, a paid account, or a real patient.

## What a week looks like

| When | What | Time |
|---|---|---|
| Before each session | Read the chapter, watch or listen to its episode, do the activity, and score yourself on the Check. | 1 to 2 hours per chapter |
| Two sessions a week | Ninety minutes on Zoom. Ten minutes of introduction, a short demo, forty minutes in breakouts of four or five doing the chapter's activity together, then report-back and the standing question: *what does this change about how you'll practice?* | 3 hours |
| Across the week | Three to five entries in the [resource log](resource-log.qmd), and a two-sentence note on whether you used a chatbot and what it got wrong. | 1 to 2 hours |
| Small group | Once a week. Each student names one resource and one surprise. | 30 to 45 minutes |

: A week in the course. The chapter times are stated in each chapter's subtitle. {#tbl-week}

Three rules hold everywhere: **no patient information enters any tool, ever;
verify before it counts; you sign the note.** What counts as patient information is on
[its own page](patient-information.qmd).

## The default order

Eleven chapters for eight sessions. The three spare chapters can be swapped in
by cohort interest. Every chapter stands alone, so a missed week costs one
chapter, not the course.

| Week | Session | Chapter |
|---|---|---|
| 1 · Orientation and stance | 1 | [How these systems work](../chapters/core-foundations.qmd) |
| | 2 | [Centaur or cyborg](../chapters/core-centaur-cyborg.qmd) |
| 2 · Judgment | 3 | [Critical appraisal](../chapters/core-appraisal.qmd) |
| | 4 | [Bias and equity](../chapters/core-bias-equity.qmd) |
| 3 · Practice | 5 | [Agentic coding](../chapters/enrichment-agentic-coding.qmd) |
| | 6 | [Talking to patients about AI](../chapters/core-patient-communication.qmd) |
| 4 · Consequences and closing | 7 | [Will AI take your job?](../chapters/enrichment-workforce-economics.qmd) *or* [What AI costs the planet](../chapters/enrichment-environment.qmd), the cohort's choice |
| | 8 | [Ethics, liability, and the device line](../chapters/core-ethics-regulation.qmd) |
| Spare | | [Prompting lab](../chapters/enrichment-prompting-lab.qmd), [Grounding AI in real sources](../chapters/enrichment-rag-notebooklm.qmd) |

: The default four-week assembly. {#tbl-order}

: Due dates for the current offering are set by the course coordinator and posted in the learning management system. {#tbl-due}

## Before the course starts

Some chapters use a chatbot. Institutional ChatGPT Edu and Microsoft Copilot
accounts are enough; no chapter needs a paid tier. Any session that needs a
separate free account says so a week ahead so that nobody creates one live.

## Grading

The course is ungraded. The resource log is marked complete or incomplete,
with short feedback in weeks 1 and 2 while the habit forms. What is expected
in each entry is on the [resource log](resource-log.qmd) page.
